reviewer: assistant visual inspection of fixed contact sheet
selection: lowest prompt_id per topic and split; objects, animals, indoor; four seeds per group
scope: 6 fixed groups, 18 reference-to-independent-instance pairs; qualitative thumbnail review, not a population estimate or B-label source

rubric.high: major object layout and spatial relations closely match
rubric.medium: shared scene organization but evident layout/detail differences
rubric.low: shared text theme with substantial arrangement/count/position differences

groups.observation: Many repeated cups and teapot-like objects across the table, beyond the requested two cups; placements and viewpoint differ between seeds.
Multiple cats and repeated/fused striped body forms instead of a single curled cat; the last seed is dominated by basket texture.
All show very dense book-covered interiors with green seating; windows, chairs and perspective differ. Fine structures are irregular.
Scattered yellow garment/boot-like fragments and repeated forms on stone; the layout differs substantially and the intended folded raincoat is poorly resolved.
Beach context is shared, but dog number, positions and scale differ; several seeds contain extra or malformed dog forms.
Kitchen shelving and utensils recur, with different window and counter layouts; shelves and small objects are unusually dense and irregular.

limitations: The fixed sample reveals high-resolution duplication/structure artifacts. It does not establish the difficulty distribution of all 120 prompts. SD1.5 was fine-tuned at 512x512; attributing all artifacts specifically to resolution is an inference, not a controlled ablation.
